svg.title: AERIS-10 — Radar head sheet-metal parts: flat patterns with bend lines — DSN-MECH-06 Rev A
svg.text: AERIS-10 — Radar head sheet-metal parts: flat patterns with bend lines — DSN-MECH-06 Rev A
Date 2026-10-09 · Units mm · scale 1:1 on the stated page · Status: PROPOSED DESIGN (D-08: Al 5754 2.5 mm, inside bend radius 2.5 mm, K-factor 0.4) · generated by tools/design_enclosure_drawings.py
Flat patterns are analytical (bend allowance added at every bend, no bend reliefs drawn) — to be checked in the fabricator's CAM before cutting

g.text: PART 1 — TRAY, flat pattern. Al 5754-H22 t = 2.5 mm; 7 bends 90°, R_in 2.5 mm, BA = 5.50 mm each (K = 0.4); PEM S-M4-1 ×18 in Ø5.4 holes; corner reliefs 2×t to be added in CAM
PART 2 — FRONT PLATE, flat (no bends), t = 2.5 mm: window 175×258, M3 clamp holes Ø3.4, M4 holes Ø4.5 to the tray front flanges, intake louvres 2 × 5
PART 3 — LID, flat, t = 2.5 mm: M4 holes Ø4.5 on the flange pattern, exhaust slots 2 × 6; EPDM gasket 15 × 3 mm under the lid on the flanges
